notes: ws_deleted is soft-deleted with a column UPDATE instead of Workspace.delete(), because the override rewrites the slug with int(deleted_at.timestamp()) (plane/db/models/workspace.py:156-176), which is not reproducible.
Ids are uuid5 from a fixed namespace, re-stamped as version 4: Plane's is_valid_uuid (plane/utils/uuid.py:8) only accepts v4 and issue_activity returns early for anything else.
No session is created for the inactive user (Django refuses to authenticate an inactive user) or for the api_bot user (a bot has no interactive session).

Invitation, API and exporter tokens are 64 lower-case hex characters so they match the `api_token` shape that scenarios/normalize.yaml applies to every JSON `token` key; the real invitation writer emits a JWT, which that shape rejects.
